nodes.name: Automated Literature Review Using NLP Techniques and LLM-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
nodes.description: The research paper explores how to automate the process of generating literature reviews using NLP techniques and a large language model.

nodes.name: Natural Language Processing (NLP) Strategies
nodes.description: Natural Language Processing strategies are utilized in this research work for automatic generation of literature reviews.

nodes.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
nodes.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation is an approach used to automate the process of generating literature reviews with a large language model.<SEP>RAG enables Large Language Models to generate grounded responses by leveraging external knowledge databases without altering model parameters.<SEP>Retrieval-Augmented Generation is a method used to make up for problems with using separate models.

nodes.description: GPT-3.5-turbo is a type of large language model utilized in this research for automatic generation of literature reviews.

nodes.name: Simple T5
nodes.description: The transformer-based model Simple T5 is used as one of the NLP strategies to generate literature reviews.

nodes.name: spaCy
nodes.description: spaCy is a natural language processing strategy used for automatic generation of literature reviews based on frequency.

nodes.name: SciTLDR dataset
nodes.description: The SciTLDR dataset is used as the basis for this research work on automated literature review generation.

nodes.name: ROUGE scores
nodes.description: The Simple T5 transformer model obtained a lower ROUGE score compared to other evaluated NLP strategies in this research.

nodes.name: DAiD
nodes.description: DAiD is a training-free plug-and-use decoding strategy that directly merges the distribution of model-predicted patches with the distribution of retrieved patches in AR-RAG.

nodes.name: ROUGE-1 score evaluation
nodes.description: The Simple T5 model was evaluated based on its ROUGE-1 score performance.

nodes.name: FAiD
nodes.description: FAiD is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that progressively smooths the features of retrieved patches via multi-scale convolution operations and leverages them to augment the image generation process in AR-RAG.

nodes.name: Image Generation
nodes.description: AR-RAG is designed for enhancing image generation tasks by incorporating autoregressive retrievals at the patch level.

nodes.name: EVOR
nodes.description: EVOR is a novel pipeline for retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) that employs the synchronous evolution of both queries and diverse knowledge bases.
